model.pre_open: Ideal pack can source to the initial bus voltage floor but cannot absorb power. The model also covers BMS opening after braking begins.
model.post_open: Capacitor supports auxiliaries plus modeled regen and dump. FOC candidate torque latches off on paper BOV or selected cutoff. Independent dump has its own 18 V comparison supply floor.
model.dump: Ideal hysteretic resistor. Gate/current timing, local parasitics and thermal qualification are outside this model.
model.torque: Actual installed FOC torque is uncredited. Candidate force is a constant-deceleration assumption, with no rotational inertia, slip, actual torque-speed/current map, or body-diode tail. One healthy FOC has half the total modeled force and no yaw model.
model.sequence: Input timings are sensitivity points; CAN loss is a separate trigger. Aux demand is fixed or steps from 70 W to 5 W, an idealized pump load-shed requirement. Positive pack source and all modeled loads are integrated.
model.results: The full case_rows table uses column names listed in case_fields. No-stop rows have null stop distance. The 5 s coasting distance is illustrative.

boundaries.resistor_thermal_rating: Unknown. No pulse or continuous capability credited.

overall: HOLD: actual two-FOC torque, independent power and gate timing, local voltage, load shutdown, battery isolation, and thermal capability are not qualified.
